newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ASX SUBSTANTIAL SHAREHOLDING NOTICES - AUG 12.
newsitem.headline: ASX SUBSTANTIAL SHAREHOLDING NOTICES - AUG 12.

text.p: The following substantial shareholder notices were made to The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) yesterday.
N.M. Rothschild & Sons (Australia) Pty Ltd increased its relevant interest in J Boag & Son Limited on 02/07/1997, from 7,465,400 ordinary shares (12.38%) to 9,557,114 ordinary shares (15.08%).

Wiwin Astuti became a substantial shareholder in Australian Authorised Investments Limited on 12/12/1996 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 3,460,000 ordinary shares (17.1%).

F.Y.E.O. AVV became a substantial shareholder in Australian Authorised Investments Limited on 12/12/1996 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 6,000,000 ordinary shares (29.6%).

Hunter Hall Investment Management Limited increased its relevant interest in Environmental Recovery Services Limited on 06/08/1997, from 2,870,815 ordinary shares (12.60%) to 3,469,949 ordinary shares (15.22%).
Axiom Properties Limited increased its relevant interest in Resource & Industry Limited on 07/08/1997, from 6,215,883 ordinary shares (15.6%) to 6,697,109 ordinary shares (16.8%).
Bankers Trust Australia Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Amcor Limited on 01/08/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 32,612,558 ordinary shares (5.10%).
Major Drilling Australia Pty Ltd increased its relevant interest in Mining World Limited on 08/08/1997, from 16,236,846 ordinary shares (92.56%) to 16,260,232 ordinary shares (92.69%).
Major Drilling Australia Pty Ltd increased its relevant interest in Mining World Limited on 07/08/1997, from 16,226,085 ordinary shares (92.49%) to 16,236,846 ordinary shares (92.56%).
Major Drilling Australia Pty Ltd increased its relevant interest in Mining World Limited MWL.AX? on 07/08/1997, from 16,226,085 ordinary shares (92.49%) to 16,236,846 ordinary shares (92.56%).
Deutsche Australia Ltd became a substantial shareholder in AAPC Limited. on 07/08/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 31,940,020 ordinary shares (5.22%).
Phileo Land Berhad became a substantial shareholder in Renak Holdings Limited on 01/04/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 6,823,678 ordinary shares (47.8%).
Simeon Wines Limited increased its relevant interest in Australian Vintage Limited on 08/08/1997, from 25,717,675 ordinary shares (69.68%) to 27,596,935 ordinary shares (74.77%).
AMP Society ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Consolidated Paper Industries (Holdings) Limited on 06/08/1997.
ADC Telecommunications Inc decreased its relevant interest in Netcomm Limited on 07/08/1997, from 2,597,403 ordinary shares (15.60%) to 1,297,403 ordinary shares (7.07%).
Camerlin Pte Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in National Foods Limited on 07/08/1997.
The National Mutual Holdings Ltd, AXA SA & associates ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Austrim Limited on 08/08/1997.
